rca_of_issue: Production bug: supervision_uploads.full_text and standards_documents.extracted_text columns were missing in production because tables existed from an older deployment, and CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS skipped adding new columns. When GET /api/prep/{meetingId}/context ran SELECT queries referencing these columns, PostgreSQL raised an error (column does not exist), causing HTTP 500. The Promise.all in MeetingPrep.js caught the 500 and showed 'Failed to load prep data' toast. Fix: (1) ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS guards in init_db.py ensure columns exist on next startup/deployment. (2) try/except blocks in prep.py around both sub-queries prevent a missing column from crashing the entire context endpoint.
